_doc: Ossa Fen at the overcast dusk (Ch10, M4-A2P-056; docs/kb/plan/act2/creatures/fen_firefly.md and fen_kingfisher.md): kingfishers darting low over the channels and sitting on the root-walk rails (their tops, y 0.5, facing the water: the perch points are along each rail's yawed line), a pair each by Walk0, Walk2 and Walk3; and fireflies low among the mangrove roots beside the Kirru's root-walks, over the tannin water (its surface y -0.25), off the walks so the party walks past them: by Walk0's left rail, Walk2's right, round the side pocket's end and by Walk4's left rail. Wildlife, not glimmer (ossa_fen.md: the fen's lights are animals, not the dead). Placed on the greybox layout (ossa_fen_layout.json); re-seat them with tools/creatures/wildlife_snap.gd and wildlife_audit.gd when the dressed kit replaces the blocks.
